head: working-tree
subject: xDS certificate SPKI pinning
change: CertificateValidationContext.verify_certificate_spki is now decoded from SDS secrets and inline CDS transport sockets as base64 SHA-256 SPKI pins. tls_material extracts each peer-chain certificate's DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo, hashes it, and requires a match after normal chain verification. The runtime SDS resolution copies SPKI pins into the cluster TLS override.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/tls_material.zig verifies matching and mismatching SPKI pins against the deterministic test certificate. src/grpc/xds/sds/secret_tests.zig covers SPKI decoding and invalid base64. src/grpc/xds/cds/tests.zig covers inline SPKI decoding. src/grpc/xds/runtime/sds_tests.zig asserts the resolved cluster carries the SDS SPKI pin.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='xDS runtime' -Dtest-filter='gRPC CDS' -Dtest-filter='gRPC LDS' -Dtest-filter='LRS' -Dtest-filter='SDS' --summary all

full_library.notes: An earlier full run failed two unrelated timing/reload cases (weighted-target least request and control-plane TLS reload); both passed in isolation and the rerun passed with no failures.

notes: Pins require trusted_ca and are additional to normal chain verification. Hash-only and SPKI-only validation contexts are not accepted yet.
